newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bombril says buys Italian firm.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bombril says buys Italian firm.

text.p: Brazilian cleaning products maker Bombril said it acquired a controlling stake of up to 80 percent in Italian food company Cirio Spa for $380 million.

The acquisition is part of Bombril's "strategy to expand business in a globalized and competitive market, which will allow the company to increase investments and use synergies to offer goods in the domestic and international markets," the firm said in a statement published in local newspapers.
Bombril plans to raise capital by 330 million reais ($311.5 million) by issuing common and preferred shares in the same existing proportion to pay for the acquisition.
The company also said its board would decide later on the conditions and price of the share issue.
It added that Cragnotti & Partners group, which owns Bombril, would maintain its 100 percent voting stake in the company and invest $120 million.
